findings.message: Full name is present and clearly legible.
Date of birth is present and consistent with the document holder's visible age.
Passport/ID number is present and in the correct format.
Document is valid and not expired.
Nationality field is present.
Photo is present but slightly blurry — legibility may be reduced for automated matching.
findings.suggestion: Request the client to resubmit a higher-resolution scan of the document.

findings.message: Account holder name matches the client's registered name.
Account number is present and correctly formatted.
Statement covers the most recent 3 months as required.
Opening and closing balances are present.
Bank name and branch details are clearly shown.
Signatory name is present and matches client records.
Effective date of the agreement is present.
Witness signature block is present but the witness name is not printed below the signature.
findings.suggestion: Request an updated copy with the witness name printed legibly beneath the signature.

findings.message: Notarisation stamp is present but the notary's registration number is not visible.
findings.suggestion: Confirm the notary's registration number with the client.

findings.message: Policy number is present and legible.
Insured name matches client records.
Coverage amount is clearly stated.
Policy expiry date is present and the policy is currently active.
Beneficiary designation is missing — this field is recommended for retirement account suitability.
findings.suggestion: Ask the client to confirm their nominated beneficiary.

findings.message: FATCA self-certification is complete and signed.
CRS tax residency declaration is present and consistent with client-provided data.
PEP declaration has been completed and is signed.
AML/KYC consent acknowledgement is present.
Sanctions screening disclosure has been signed.
GDPR / data processing consent is present and dated.
Registered company name is present.
Company registration number is present.
Directors list is present but one entry is missing a date of birth.
findings.suggestion: Request the missing director date of birth from the client.

findings.message: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) declaration is missing for one shareholder with >25% ownership.
findings.suggestion: Request a completed UBO declaration form for the identified beneficial owner.

findings.message: Certificate of incorporation is present and within the last 12 months.
